input: 26-point raw causal history plus commands and actuator proxies; no pretrained GRU to contaminate temporal holdout
target_normalization: same raw-train scales in every cell
phase_normalization: fixed sin/cos mean0 std1 for both representations
phase_correction: train earlier-half constant offsets; validation offset unknown and set0; no validation offset calibration
fit_scope: first70percent each train log minus2s; temporal heldout last30percent plus2s; fit_stride2
